commit.message:
Rename runtime binaries to zoekt- and add hyperzoekt components (#34)

* squash: Rename runtimes to zoekt-*, add hyperzoekt components, add /health probes, docker-compose fixes, and test updates

* embeddings: use SurrealDB vector::similarity::cosine for server-side similarity in embed worker

* docs: describe server-side similarity (embeddings) behavior and config

* web: validate search forms to prevent empty queries

* embeds: exclude self and short sources from similarity queries; add min source chars config

* docker: use musl static build with Chainguard minimal runtime; fallback to glibc image

* squash: runtime & webui fixes — pass context, add logging, attempt Alpine runtime with compatibility packages, update compose/helm

* log: indexer request URL and context_lines; update Dockerfile (local edits)
